events.title: Earlier illustrated-book identity documented
events.summary: The cover of the district’s 2010–2011 annual report uses an illustrated open-book and landscape emblem with the full district name. The report period documents a historical sighting; no initial adoption date is asserted.

events.title: Book-and-wings identity announced
events.summary: The CSF announced a simpler, more modern identity centred on a book resembling wings, using blue and a gold central page. The article says the board unanimously approved it the previous weekend and that introduction would proceed over following months. The 2012–2013 annual-report cover supplies a historical visual of this design.

events.title: Three-colour CSF identity announced
events.summary: The CSF announced a new identity following its 25th anniversary and strategic-plan consultations. Its stated palette meanings are reconciliation, Indigenous education and diversity for orange; inclusion and wellbeing for yellow; and youth and development for blue. An interwoven pattern accompanies the new acronym-based mark.
